0022600223.text: The New Orleans Pelicans, 4-7 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Brooklyn Nets, who are 2-8 and have lost two straight, in the Pelicans' 12th game of the season. Out for New Orleans are Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision. For Brooklyn, Mikel Brown Jr. is out with an illness and Nolan Traore is day-to-day with calf soreness and a game-time decision, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Pelicans winning the last meeting 116-113 in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
